card.name: Academic citations and author names
card.fires_on: Marked word sits in scholarly humanities text, often at the start of an author's name in a reference or bibliography, or inside a title or year. Settings are theology, philosophy and semiotics.

modes.label: Author name starts in references
modes.description: The first piece of a surname or first name in a citation or reference list.

modes.label: Titles and institutes in theology/philosophy
modes.description: Small words inside institute names or book titles in theology and philosophy bios.
modes.example: Claremont, California, and Co-Director of the Center<< for>> Process Studies there.

modes.label: Digits in citation numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a year or Peirce-style citation number.

card.writes: It nudges output toward humanities and philosophy words such as mindfulness, existential and solidarity.
card.plain: It fires on author names, titles and dates in scholarly philosophy and theology writing, not on drug-label text.
